mapper.select: SELECT s.step_id AS stepId, s.project_id AS projectId, pm.permission AS permission FROM step s JOIN project p ON p.project_id = s.project_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN project_member pm ON pm.project_id = s.project_id AND pm.user_id = #{userId} WHERE s.step_id = #{stepId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT block_id AS blockId, step_id AS stepId FROM block WHERE block_id = #{blockId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
